title: An accordion with room to breathe
description: An interruptible height transition that keeps related answers together.
useCase: Reveal short answers, feature details or a compact process without taking the user to a new page.
reducedMotion: Sections open immediately. Keyboard activation also skips the height transition.
limitations: A height animation requires layout. Keep each answer short; check long content on slower devices.
look: Warm off-white page with a narrow stack of hairline-divided rows: plain sans-serif headings, plus icons at right, and one open row showing grey body text.
motion: Clicking a heading springs its panel from zero to auto height with a fade (0.3 s, no bounce) as the open one collapses; the plus turns 45° into a cross.
adapt: Each panel is a `motion.div` inside `AnimatePresence` animating `height` from 0 to `"auto"` with `{ type: "spring", duration: 0.3, bounce: 0 }`; the icon is a `motion.span` rotating to 45. Replace `items` with your content; `expanded` allows one open section at a time.
